name: portrait-jobs-http
summary: Same-origin Settings API for starting one bounded portrait research Agent Session and reading its latest status.
rationale: This is a browser-to-Host product seam, not an Agent tool. Research creates a durable temporary Session, so POST requests require same-origin validation and an explicit marker. Paid live probes are deliberately excluded and require separate explicit Agent approval.

methods.GET: Return the latest in-memory job view, if any.
methods.POST: Validate and queue one research job; returns HTTP 202 after queueing.

postRequiredHeaders.origin: http(s) origin whose host equals the Host header

request.action: must be research; probe is rejected
request.ids: optional non-empty array of at most 100 exact target ids already configured or selected in the current profile; catalog-only ids are rejected

response.ok: true when status was read or a job was queued; false on validation or runtime failure
response.job: latest bounded job view labelled temporary workspace, with status, target ids, phase, timestamps, optional summary/error, and optional visible sessionId
response.error: present when ok is false; never includes credential values

lifecycle: At most one job is queued or running per plugin instance. Each job reserves a distinct child from dsh-temporary-workspace, creates its visible Agent Session with that child as cwd, and adopts it as an independent Workspace. The active Agent handle is disposed at completion or plugin stop; the Session and Workspace remain user-recoverable.
cost: Research wrappers force liveProbe=false. A paid probe is outside this protocol and requires separate explicit user approval before validate_model_portrait(liveProbe=true).
